sentences.text: Ganzhousaurus is defined by a unique combination of primitive and advanced anatomical traits.
Fossils of this animal were uncovered in a Maastrichtian geological deposit.
The genus contains only one known species, Ganzhousaurus nankangensis.
Researchers suggest that Ganzhousaurus was primarily herbivorous.
The animal is considered to have been primarily herbivorous.
Ganzhousaurus lived alongside at least four other oviraptorid species in the same habitat.
Scientific analysis classifies Ganzhousaurus as a member of the family Oviraptoridae.
Ganzhousaurus belongs to the dinosaur family Oviraptoridae.
Phylogenetic analysis places Ganzhousaurus within the family Oviraptoridae.
The parent group for Ganzhousaurus is identified as Heyuanninae.
The dinosaur lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Nanxiong Formation of Nankang County in southern China.
It lived approximately 70 to 66 million years ago during the late Cretaceous period.
Ganzhousaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
There is debate regarding Ganzhousaurus's exact position within Oviraptoridae, with some studies placing it in Oviraptorinae and others linking it closely to Ingeniinae.
Studies disagree on whether Ganzhousaurus is a member of Oviraptorinae or a more derived group related to Ingeniinae.
